codegen.scope: macOS arm64 Release normal dylibs; total function instructions include cold branches, not a cycle estimate
codegen.observation: Both hybrid getters retain two acquire loads; direct slot publication removes one ordinary owner-to-slots load. Actual executable text and numeric Bean call sites each lose that same load.

diagnostic_pair_comparison.scope: Diagnostic requested layouts, calls, hits and records; not normal allocator physical decomposition.

abi_layouts.scope: Actual normal and diagnostic object sizes on desktop plus four NDK ABIs; the previous cache owner/field layout was unchanged by the hot-entry source increment.

limitations: ASan/UBSan and concurrency execution were on the host; leak detection was disabled.
Android evidence covers four ABI builds, not Android execution/performance.
Latches and conversion counters are diagnostic-only; normal component checks do not execute those hooks.
Diagnostic deque requests are not an exact attribution of normal physical allocations.
Full frozen/independent API oracles precede the timed count/checksum checks.
